positive_controls.argument: Early control requirements and credible verification questions make trust boundaries, reliability limits or hazardous interactions explicit in the feasibility trade before the expensive commitment.
Credible design, implementation and integration checks can supply identified parts of the envelope argument and expose defects early, with configuration and evidence scope retained.

Lifecycle integration makes hazard controls part of actual engineering work and preserves implementation and verification links as the system changes, rather than relying solely on a terminal inspection.
Earlier implemented and checked controls supply relevant technical evidence and reduce avoidable late surprises in the readiness decision while leaving actual operational conditions explicit.
Lifecycle risk controls can make recovery mechanisms testable and maintain their integrity, including access, compatibility and failure containment rather than adding an unexamined emergency path.
Extending relevant controls through operation, dependency change and vulnerability response gives continuing support an actual checked correction mechanism beyond initial acceptance.
Risk and control evidence from the lifecycle identifies the failure mode a proposed assurance measure addresses and whether existing checks already close it, informing control selection.

The actual control and failure mechanism distinguish avoided exposure, architectural lock-in and repair effort, showing how a particular early intervention can be useful without the universal phase-cost claim.

member_to_common_premise.actual_object: An actual lifecycle task needs a proportionate set of quality, security or reliability controls.
member_to_common_premise.literal_bridge: Risk and control evidence from the lifecycle identifies the failure mode a proposed assurance measure addresses and whether existing checks already close it, informing control selection.

member_to_premise_evidence.shared_question_or_object: Early lifecycle assurance is justified by a claim that all later defect correction is exponentially more expensive.

source.bearer: A lifecycle with consequential design, implementation, dependency or operational risks.
source.criterion: Address quality, security and reliability throughout relevant work rather than treating final inspection as their only control.

receiver.bearer: The universal exponential relationship between later change and cost
receiver.criterion: Reject a universal exponential law; distinguish development repair effort from propagation, unwinding commitments and failure/recovery loss.

guard: An actual artifact, state, configuration, population, time horizon and receiving decision are identified as specified in the literal common-object field.
The exact native source mechanism contributes the named evidence, constraint, capability or interpretation to that receiving use. Generic possible co-use is insufficient.
Edit effort, propagation, commitment unwinding and failure/recovery losses remain separate; a partial reduction is material without establishing complete reversibility.
Authority, representative evidence, hidden state, shared failure domains, response capability and binding constraints remain separate premises.
Unknown correspondence remains unknown; a low-consequence cheap path and an adequate existing mechanism remain eligible.
member_to_premise_evidence.source_contribution: The actual control and failure mechanism distinguish avoided exposure, architectural lock-in and repair effort, showing how a particular early intervention can be useful without the universal phase-cost claim.

premises_supplied: The actual control and failure mechanism distinguish avoided exposure, architectural lock-in and repair effort, showing how a particular early intervention can be useful without the universal phase-cost claim.
premises_remaining: Reject a universal exponential law; distinguish development repair effort from propagation, unwinding commitments and failure/recovery loss.
All receiver-native scope, authority and evidence conditions beyond the literal partial contribution; actual net benefit remains to be established.
member_to_premise_evidence.counterexample: One catastrophic late defect does not prove a universal exponential repair curve; an early irrelevant scan can be pure cost.
member_to_premise_evidence.counter_control: One catastrophic late defect does not prove a universal exponential repair curve; an early irrelevant scan can be pure cost.
member_to_premise_evidence.nontrigger: The specified actual shared object, mechanism or receiving use is known absent. If it is merely unestablished, retain that uncertainty rather than declaring no relationship.
specific_cost_and_alternative: Account for structural work, requalification, telemetry, isolation, rehearsal, backup, coexistence, maintenance and delayed beneficial change; do not count the same shared capacity twice.
Compare existing verified seams, a manual controlled release, targeted checks, simulation, a qualified pilot, roll-forward repair, replacement and deliberate retirement as applicable.
A frozen stage, infrequent release or no change may be adequate; no universal deployment cadence or additional approver follows.
Binding constraints and explicitly nontradeable harms limit the choice set independently of ordinary service-budget economics.
member_to_premise_evidence.reentry: Reopen the affected literal direction if configuration, state, population, timing, coupling, exposure, recovery evidence, source version, receiving use, support horizon or authority changes. A failed guard does not establish a global negative; reverse and transitive claims require separate inquiry.
